name: @tomgrv/svc-cloudflare
description: Cloudflare Tunnel as the internal network (alternative to Tailscale)

CLOUDFLARE_INTERNAL_IP.description: Address WARP clients use to reach this VPS through the tunnel (a /32 on a dummy interface)

CLOUDFLARE_TUNNEL_TOKEN.description: Cloudflare Tunnel token (Zero Trust > Networks > Tunnels)

CLOUDFLARE_VERSION.description: cloudflared release to install, e.g. 2025.1.0 (empty = latest)

CLOUDFLARE_SHA256.description: sha256 of that release's binary, or a JSON object keyed <os>_<arch> (empty = not checked)
